newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Mah Sing in Indonesian venture.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Mah Sing in Indonesian venture.

text.p: Mah Sing Group Bhd said on Monday that its 80 percent owned subsidiary, PT Mah Sing Indonesia has entered into an agreement with Premium Vector Sdn Bhd to jointly set up a manufacturing company in Indonesia.
The joint venture company, PT Multi Plas Indonesia, will make and assemble plastic injection components mainly for the audio industry, Mah Sing said in a statement.
It said the initial issued and paid-up capital of PT Multi Plas would be $3 million, of which Mah Sing would subscribe for 35 percent.
PT Multi Plas will set up a factory in Jakarta which is expected to be ready by the end of 1997, it added.
